journey.title: Produce a guided backdrop, and understand what it cost and what it discloses
journey.purpose: The model-backed loop: a composition scaffold steers generation so the layout is authored rather than sampled, the treatment pass binds the result to the brand palette, and the AI-generated flag is derived from the strategy rather than asserted by anyone.

steps.intent: Find a style whose subject is too intricate to draw procedurally, and see that it is marked as metered before opening it.
See the composition scaffold that will steer generation, including the reserved-region voids drawn into it as flat geometry.

Read the resolved plan — the ai-gateway role and profile rather than a model name, the conditioning image, the treatment chain that will run afterwards — and see the expected cost before authorising it.
Understand that this machine could not serve the request locally and it was routed onward, so a slower or lower-tier result is attributable rather than mysterious.
Confirm the treated output is palette-locked to the active brand and clears the legibility threshold, then select one candidate explicitly.
See the AI-generated flag shown alongside the strategy it was derived from, with the asset-studio provenance reference recording spend and model.
